data.long_meaning: Annia is a feminine name of Roman origin. It is derived from the Latin word 'annus', meaning 'grace' or 'mercy'. In Christian context, Anna is the name of several saints and biblical figures, including the mother of Hannah, the prophetess who recognized Jesus as the Messiah. The name Annia carries the meaning “Grace, Mercy” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Annia usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, mercy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
